# the paths that run .github/workflows/oracle-status.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow, when it has one, must list the same patterns in
# the same order (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file a job of the workflow executes or reads is listed: a missing one skips the
# job on a change that alters it
# gen-oracle-status.py reads tests/*.rs; src/**/*.rs is kept from the previous filter
tests/**/*.rs
src/**/*.rs
# the dependency versions come from Cargo.lock; `cargo metadata --locked` reads the
# manifest and the lock with the pinned toolchain
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
rust-toolchain.toml
scripts/gen-oracle-status.py
# the committed ledger is compared with the regenerated one
docs/oracle-status.md
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/oracle-status.yml
.github/paths/oracle-status.txt
